question: In which of the following years was the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015 amended?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2021**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015** was amended in the year **2021**.
 
• The amendment aimed to strengthen the provisions for the protection and care of children.
 
• It introduced measures to streamline the adoption process and ensure the welfare of children in need of care and protection.
 
• The amendment also provided for more robust mechanisms to deal with juvenile offenders and enhanced the role of Child Welfare Committees and Juvenile Justice Boards.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act** was originally enacted in **2000** and was later replaced by the **2015 Act** to address the changing needs and challenges in the juvenile justice system.
 
• The **2015 Act** introduced significant changes, including the provision to try juveniles in the age group of 16-18 years as adults for heinous offenses.
 
• The amendment in **2021** further refined the legal framework to ensure the effective implementation of the Act and better protection for children.
 
• The Act is a crucial piece of legislation that aligns with India's commitment to child rights and welfare as outlined in the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child (UNCRC).
